headline: Meta's Muse Charm may cost $300, per The Information
summary: Meta reportedly plans to price its Muse Charm AI gadget at $300, according to The Information, and Meta has not denied the report, saying only that it will share more soon. Zuckerberg revealed the device earlier this year and said Meta expected to ship it by the December holidays. One outlet reports it may also include a free Verizon 5G data plan, a detail the other outlets' given text does not mention.
